features.name: 4-layer memory subsystem
features.description: Working / episodic / semantic / graph layers backed by SQLite + FTS5 + optional HNSW vector index.

features.name: 6-stage compaction pipeline
features.description: Hierarchical compaction with budget-aware section dropping and skill-budget reserve.

features.name: Hardware tiers + auto-detection
features.description: Three GPU tiers (Constrained / Balanced / Full) with auto-detect and override.

features.name: Plan mode (toggle + step states)
features.description: Plan mode toggle, draft / approve / reject step transitions, capability reminder.

features.name: MCP client + opt-in server (stdio)
features.description: MCP client integrates external MCP tools; opt-in stdio server exposes the read-only subset.

features.name: HNSW vector index for semantic search
features.description: Optional hnswlib-node-backed index for memory semantic recall, activated at row-count threshold.

features.name: Deterministic checks CLI (bin/gemma-check.mjs)
features.description: Standalone CLI that runs deterministic rules (no-secret-patterns, console-noise, todo-without-issue, missing-tests) and emits JSON or text.

features.name: Background workers (audit + testgaps)
features.description: Opt-in BackgroundWorkers that spawn gemma-check and vitest --coverage off the agent loop hot path.

features.name: Webview render protocol (7 primitives)
features.description: DIFF_CARD, ACTION_TAG, PERMISSION_PROMPT, TODO_BLOCK, THOUGHT_META_ROW, QUEUED_MESSAGE_FIELD, COMPLETION_REPORT.

features.name: Compaction summary prefix framing
features.description: Compaction outputs are prefixed with framing text that flags the summary as background reference, not active instructions.

features.name: Plan-mode denial template
features.description: Strong-framed denial template emitted as a system message on plan/step deny.

features.name: Plan-mode capabilities reminder
features.description: Capabilities note describing the 7 render primitives injected on plan-mode entry.

features.name: Plan approveWithNotes path
features.description: Plan can be approved while attaching implementation notes for the executor.

features.name: feature_list.json scope contract
features.description: Machine-readable feature list with loader, validator, and golden-suite pass-state stamping.

features.name: init.sh / init.ps1 lifecycle bootstrap
features.description: 5-step verified bootstrap: install, lint, build, harness-files check, sample-assets check.

features.name: Clean-state end-of-session gate + scanner
features.description: 30-item end-of-session checklist plus cleanup-scanner.mjs that surfaces orphan rows, dangling embeddings, deleted-path references, and stale cache files.

features.name: Pass-state gating in AgentLoop
features.description: AgentLoop refuses to declare task done unless a verification-class tool call has succeeded since the last user message.

features.name: Frozen memory snapshot at session start
features.description: MemorySnapshot captures Instructions.md / Memory.md / Context.md once per session so prefix caches stay warm.

features.name: Streaming memory-context scrubber FSM
features.description: Stateful FSM that strips <memory-context> spans from streaming chunks across boundary splits.

features.name: Prompt-injection scanner
features.description: Pattern + invisible-unicode scanner enforced at MemoryStore write and MemoryFiles read boundaries.

features.name: Extended SKILL.md YAML frontmatter
features.description: Skill loader accepts version, platforms, metadata.tags, metadata.related_skills; mirror parser in package-skills.mjs round-trips through 4 harness adapters.
